positions.title: Python Backend Developer
positions.description:
Developed Python backend services and REST APIs supporting financial application workflows, improving backend reliability by approximately 18% through structured validation, exception handling, and reusable service components.
Engineered API integrations across 4+ internal services, processing approximately 15K–20K requests per month while maintaining consistent request validation, response handling, and service-to-service communication.
Optimized backend processing and database interactions for frequently used workflows, reducing average API response time by approximately 22% through query improvements and more efficient application logic.
Refactored reusable Python modules using OOP, SOLID principles, clean code, and modular design, reducing duplicated backend logic by approximately 15% and simplifying recurring feature enhancements.
Developed PyTest unit and integration tests for backend components and API endpoints, increasing automated test coverage to approximately 80% and reducing regression defects across application releases.
Diagnosed and resolved approximately 8–12 production issues per month using application logs, debugging, exception analysis, and root-cause investigation, helping maintain stable backend service operations.
Collaborated with QA, DevOps, product, and engineering teams across 2-week Agile sprints, contributing to approximately 2–3 backend releases per month through development, code reviews, testing, and deployment support.
